ABOUT THE PEES MODEL COLLEGE, IRAYE-EPE

THE PEES MODEL COLLEGE is a forward-thinking private secondary school located in the heart of Iraye-Epe, Epe, Lagos State, Nigeria.

Founded on the principles of Excellence, Discipline, and Integrity, we are committed to delivering holistic education that develops the academic, moral, and social potential of every student.

Our school offers

  • Junior Secondary School (JSS 1–3)
  • Senior Secondary School (SSS 1–3) — Arts, Commercial and Science
  • Well-qualified and dedicated teachers
  • Conducive classrooms and modern learning facilities
  • Strong focus on BECE, WASSCE and JAMB preparation
  • Moral discipline and character development

At THE PEES MODEL COLLEGE, we don’t just teach — we build future leaders, innovators, and responsible citizens.

Address: Aina Abidakun Street 5, 5 Bus Stop, Iraye-Epe, Lagos, Nigeria.

Established: September 9, 2023
Boarding facilities: In view
School motto: “GREATER GLORY”

WHY CHOOSE US?

  • Qualified and dedicated teachers
  • Conducive classrooms and modern learning facilities
  • BECE, WASSCE and JAMB preparation
  • Arts, Commercial and Science pathways
  • Moral discipline and character development
  • Excellence, Discipline and Integrity

COMPLETE MGR RANKING
10 Tiers · 100 Ranks · Original MGR Geometric Symbols
Each Tier contains exactly 10 ranks. Every rank uses the symbol, colours, shape, meaning and qualification days from the supplied MGR ranking software.
100Ranks
10Tiers


Qualification30 days per rank
Rank 130 days
Rank 1003,000 days
AcceptanceMonthly approval must be accepted


Promotion & salary: The ranking does not calculate or reduce salary. Where a school promotion requires a particular rank, the required rank must be reached and verified before that promotion benefit can take effect. Missed/unaccepted service cycles do not count.




Authorised administrators can view retained name, contact, final rank and qualification record.

Rank 1,000 time30,000 days ≈ 82.14 years
BasisTPMC extension assumes 30 qualification days per rank after Rank 100; the supplied MGR source itself defines ranks through 100.

Frequently asked questions
Quick answers about using the school website.


How do I register my child?
Choose Register Your Child, select the class, then follow the form. You can also message an administrator on WhatsApp if you need help.


How do I pay school fees?
Open School Fees & Payments, choose the class, and follow the payment steps.


Where can I see my child's results?
Use School Results from the home page or the three-bar menu. You will be asked to verify access.


Who do I contact for help?
Use the Support button in the bottom bar to message an administrator on WhatsApp, or email the school from the Contact section below.


Contact the school
Reach an administrator directly. We reply during school hours.


WhatsApp
Chat with an administrator about admissions, fees or results.
Email
Send a written enquiry to the school office.
